dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service contains boundary line information for Westbank First Nation. It supports spatial reference and boundary-based mapping for administrative area representation within the community.

Feature Layers
  • Administrative Areas: Polygon boundary features representing the administrative extent of Westbank First Nation. The layer includes identifying attributes such as the area name and common name for use in map display, boundary management, and jurisdictional reference.
Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation in British Columbia and is intended for local boundary and administrative area use.

Use Cases
  • Boundary mapping and reference for Westbank First Nation lands
  • Administrative area display in web maps and GIS applications
  • Supporting local planning, recordkeeping, and jurisdictional context
Source and Licensing

The service is maintained by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and is made available under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License, with associated disclaimer and terms of use.
